2105-4598-7175-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4598-7175-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4598-7175-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2034-3129-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.

2169-2829-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-2829-4694-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

720-1806-2034-5708.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-1806-2034-5708.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

997-1619-4605-5542-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
997-1619-4605-5542-6151.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Underdark Explorer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Underdark Explorer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Underdark Explorer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1619-4605-5542-6151.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

4446-4496-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
4446-4496-5220-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-4302-4509-5434.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
3259-4302-4509-5434.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

80-1618-2440-4258.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Sedgemoor Witch
80-1618-2440-4258.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Venture Forth.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.
80-1618-2440-4258.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Sedgemoor Witch. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

647-2440-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
647-2440-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

2292-6528-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

803-1238-2351-5467-6798.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

2730-4871-5006-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
When Lurrus of the Dream-Den dies, Kaya's Ghostform and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform trigger, returning Lurrus of the Dream-Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
Repeat.

1575-5315-6748.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Ragost.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

3372-4050-5295-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-5295-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

1170-1645-1770-5954-6664.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Crown of Flames spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Crown of Flames by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2267-2558-3698--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2267-2558-3698--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Tormod and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

2073-5226-6522.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Mandibular Kite from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mandibular Kite enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Mandibular Kite to it.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Mandibular Kite.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

488-2478-3200-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites: One of either Mishra's Bauble or Urza's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-2478-3200-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2060-2265-4893-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2265-4893-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

804-2438-2533-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat.

880-5478-5671.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-5478-5671.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2018-2946-4050.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2018-2946-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Cult Conscript from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {1}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2366-3585-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1071-2705-3158-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to you and Volcano Hellion.
Instead of you losing the game as a state-based action, Lich's Mirror causes you to shuffle your hand, graveyard and all permanents you own into your library, causing Rhox Faithmender to return to the battlefield as Suspension Field leaves the battlefield, and causing you to gain life equal to twice the amount of damage dealt to you plus 40.

703-2557-2726.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Astral Dragon spell.
Resolve the copy of the Astral Dragon spell, putting one token copy of Astral Dragon onto the battlefield (note this is not "created" so it is not doubled).
When the Astral Dragon token enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, creating four token copies of Parallel Lives that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the original Astral Dragon spell from step 1.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating 64 token copies of Parallel Lives that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

849-1812-2034-3240.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {C}{C}.
Nether Traitor dies, triggering Anax, crating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Satyr token, adding {C}{C}.
The Satyr dies, triggering Nether Traitor, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
